name: The Active Agent
label: Quest
description: The Active Agent: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You will have to delve deeper into Stratholme, friend.
Beyond the first gates you will find the ziggurats. We know that the Scourge draws great power from these structures. Search the Ziggurats and return with any information that you may discover.

clips.title: Progress
paras: We are on the verge of discovering what this new active plague agent may be!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Astonishing! This will take months to dissect and analyze. The Argent Dawn thanks you for your efforts, friend.

With our blessing, take your pick between either this Seal of the Dawn or this Rune of the Dawn. You can use either of them instead of a standard Argent Dawn Commission to collect scourgestones on our behalf. Should you lose yours, speak with me and I'll get you a replacement.
